name: bonsai
description: Prune your Claude Code context instead of summarizing it: stale and oversized tool results go, your conversation, decisions and plans stay verbatim.

triggerPercent.title: Proactive prune above (%)
triggerPercent.description: Prune on its own once the context passes this percentage of the window. 0 turns it off and leaves only /compact and Claude Code's automatic compaction.

retryGrowth.title: Retry after growing (points %)
retryGrowth.description: If a prune found nothing to remove, only try again after the context grew by this much.

preserveRecent.title: Recent messages left untouched
preserveRecent.description: How many messages at the end of the conversation are never altered.

keepMaxChars.title: Largest old tool result (characters)
keepMaxChars.description: Old tool results longer than this are cut (their start and end stay).

headChars.title: Start kept when cutting (characters)
headChars.description: How much of the beginning of a cut result stays.

tailChars.title: End kept when cutting (characters)
tailChars.description: How much of the end of a cut result stays (errors and conclusions tend to be at the end).

minSavingsPercent.title: Minimum savings for a prune to count (%)
minSavingsPercent.description: If pruning saves less than this, /compact and automatic compaction fall back to Claude Code's own summary. The proactive prune simply gives up.

pruneInputs.title: Also prune old tool-call inputs
pruneInputs.description: Cuts the long fields of old tool calls, such as the content of a Write or the strings of an Edit. The file on disk is the source of truth, so the old text is dead weight.

relink.title: Keep the prune when resuming a session
relink.description: Rebuilds the messages after the first pruned one so that --continue/--resume does not restore the original history. Turn off only to debug.

keepTools.title: Tools whose results are never pruned
keepTools.description: Comma-separated names. Default: subagent conclusions, user answers and plans.
